title: Bug report: Miao2 & Miband bluetooth conection problem
symptom: xDrip loses Bluetooth connection to Miao Miao 2 or Mi Band 5 usually once every two days, and it never reconnects automatically. The user has to manually reconnect via the 'Bluetooth Scan' menu.
evidence_quote: Xdrip loses bluetooth Miao Miao 2 or Mi band5 usally one time in two days. And it never connect it again by it self. I have to connect it again in 'Bluetooth Scan' menu.
